title: Strict cone presentations with prescribed endpoint components
statement: Let C be an abelian category with a derived category. Given two distinguished triangles in its derived category and maps on the first and third vertices commuting with the connecting morphisms, there are cochain complexes A,B,A',B', strict maps t,t',α,β with t≫β=α≫t' and isomorphisms from A,B,Cone(t),A',B',Cone(t') to the six triangle vertices, transporting the first maps, cone inclusions, and the prescribed first and third components.

source.place: Tag 014D, cone functoriality for homotopy-commuting squares

proof.text: Rotate the triangles, represent the finite diagram by roofs of complexes, refine roofs to a homotopy-commuting square, and choose chain representatives for the maps and homotopy.

Replace one arrow by the cylinder factorization, use cone functoriality to strictify, and rotate back. The resulting cone isomorphisms preserve the endpoint maps and establish every displayed identity.

theorem derived_endpoint_cone_presentation
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} C]
    (T T' : Triangle (DerivedCategory C))
    (hT : T ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory C))
    (hT' : T' ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory C))
    (a : T.obj₁ ⟶ T'.obj₁) (c : T.obj₃ ⟶ T'.obj₃)
    (h : T.mor₃ ≫ a⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' =
      c ≫ T'.mor₃) :
    ∃ (A B A' B' : CochainComplex C ℤ)
      (t : A ⟶ B) (t' : A' ⟶ B') (α : A ⟶ A') (β : B ⟶ B')
      (hc : t ≫ β = α ≫ t')
      (e₁ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj A ≅ T.obj₁)
      (e₂ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj B ≅ T.obj₂)
      (e₃ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.mappingCone t) ≅ T.obj₃)
      (e₁' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj A' ≅ T'.obj₁)
      (e₂' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj B' ≅ T'.obj₂)
      (e₃' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.mappingCone t') ≅ T'.obj₃),
      DerivedCategory.Q.map t ≫ e₂.hom = e₁.hom ≫ T.mor₁ ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr t) ≫ e₃.hom =
        e₂.hom ≫ T.mor₂ ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map t' ≫ e₂'.hom = e₁'.hom ≫ T'.mor₁ ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr t') ≫ e₃'.hom =
        e₂'.hom ≫ T'.mor₂ ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map α ≫ e₁'.hom = e₁.hom ≫ a ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (CochainComplex.mappingCone.map t t' α β hc) ≫ e₃'.hom =
        e₃.hom ≫ c
